text: You then, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
And what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, entrust to faithful people who will be capable of teaching others as well.
Take your share of suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in civilian affairs; his aim is to please the one who enlisted him.
And an athlete is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
The farmer who does the hard work should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
Think over what I am saying, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David — this is my gospel,
for which I suffer to the point of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God is not chained.
So I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
This saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he will also deny us;
if we are faithless, he remains faithful — for he cannot deny himself.
Keep reminding them of these things, charging them before the Lord not to quarrel about words. It does no good and only ruins those who listen.

versions.text: Keep reminding them of these things, charging them before God not to quarrel about words. It does no good and only ruins those who listen.
versions.explanation: The base text here reads κυρίου ("the Lord"), not θεοῦ ("God"). Rendering it as "the Lord" matches the underlying text and preserves the reading; a footnote could note the variant "God."

text: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
Avoid godless chatter, for those who indulge in it will only wander further into ungodliness,
and their talk will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
who have missed the truth by saying that the resurrection has already taken place, and they are overturning the faith of some.
Yet God's firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Let everyone who names the name of the Lord turn away from wickedness."
In a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver but also of wood and clay — some for honorable use, some for dishonorable.
So if anyone cleanses himself from what is dishonorable, he will be a vessel for honorable use, set apart as holy, useful to the master of the house, ready for every good work.
Flee the desires of youth, and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
Have nothing to do with foolish and ignorant controversies; you know they breed quarrels.
And the Lord's servant must not be quarrelsome but kind to everyone, able to teach, patient when wronged,
correcting his opponents with gentleness. Perhaps God will grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth,

so that they may come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.[^1]

[^1]: Or: having been captured by him (the devil), to do God's will. The Greek uses two different pronouns, and the referents are debated.

versions.text: so that they may come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.
versions.explanation: The Greek shifts pronouns (ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ... εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα), which many understand as two different referents. A brief footnote alerts the reader to the recognized ambiguity without changing the main rendering.
